The '''Heilbronn Institute for Mathematical Research''' is a national research institute for mathematics based at the [[University of Bristol]]. It is named after the distinguished number theorist [[Hans Heilbronn]] who worked at Bristol University from 1934&ndash;1935 and 1946&ndash;1964.<ref>{{MacTutor Biography|id=Heilbronn|title=Hans Heilbronn}}</ref> The Institute was founded in 2005 and is run as a partnership between the UK [[GCHQ|Government Communications Headquarters]] and the UK academic mathematics community.  It has facilities in Bristol, London and Manchester. As of September 2023, the Chair of the Institute is [[Catherine Hobbs]], having succeeded [[Geoffrey Grimmett]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Heilbronn Institute for Mathematical Research {{!}} Professor Catherine Hobbs Appointed Chair of the Heilbronn Institute |url=https://heilbronn.ac.uk/2023/02/20/new-chair-himr/ |access-date=2024-01-05 |language=en-US}}</ref>

The Institute has headquarters in the [[Fry Building]] of Bristol University, to which it moved in September 2019 together with the School of Mathematics of the University.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.bristol.ac.uk/maths/news/2019/fry-building.html | title=Bristol mathematics moves to Fry Building | access-date=30 September 2019 | archive-date=16 October 2019 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191016053435/http://www.bristol.ac.uk/maths/news/2019/fry-building.html | url-status=dead }}</ref>
